items.expected: Define atom counts, lattice/geometry, magnetic treatment, Hamiltonian and energy reference. Compare balanced systems, or include justified chemical potentials when composition changes. Any surface, defect or pathway claim needs evidence sufficient for its own finite-size, structural and numerical assumptions.

Develop a quantitative atomistic account of the observed Ni-rich precipitation within source material and facet boundaries. The choice of defect, surface or other models is agent-designed; no old fixed three-termination or two-supercell matrix is mandatory.

items.statement: Evidence that distinguishes the claimed explanation
items.expected: Demonstrate that the proposed bulk–surface explanation is supported by internally consistent energy comparisons and meaningful alternatives. Reservoir, atom conservation and magnetic reference errors must not manufacture selectivity.

Establish uncertainty and applicability for the actual models and claims: convergence, structural relaxation, magnetic state and finite-size effects where relevant. If kinetics is claimed, supply appropriate pathway/rate evidence; a thermodynamic answer may instead explicitly delimit kinetics.
